---
title: "Individual Concentration Distributions - Nahan et al."
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

fitdistcens(censdata, distr, start=NULL, fix.arg=NULL, keepdata = TRUE, keepdata.nb=100, calcvcov=TRUE, ...)

censdata\
A dataframe of two columns respectively named left and right, describing each observed value as an interval. The left column contains either NA for left censored observations, the left bound of the interval for interval censored observations, or the observed value for non-censored observations. The right column contains either NA for right censored observations, the right bound of the interval for interval censored observations, or the observed value for non-censored observations.

# USPF

```{r}
table2_data <- c(29.4, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 29.2, "N.D.", "N.D.", 76.5, 89.5, "N.D.", 36.1, "N.D.", "N.D.", 133.6, 208.6, "N.D.", 35.9, "N.D.", 31.2, 31.4, 247.3, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 30.7, 93.6, 76.2, 29.0, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 89.7, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 29.2, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.")

# LC/MS Data
table3_data <- c("N.D.", "N.D.", 7.9, 6.6, "N.D.", "N.D.", 3.4, "N.D.", 
       "N.D.", "N.D.", 44.4, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 
       119.7, 3.2, "N.D.", 4.4, "N.D.", 8.0, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.")
table4_data <- c("N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 1611, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 
       "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 2574, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 
       "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 1686, 288, 27, 613, 
       711, "N.D.", "N.D.", 133, "N.D.", "N.D.", 509, "N.D.", 
       "N.D.", 184, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 
       236, "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", "N.D.", 292,

```

LOQ GC/MS: $100~\mu\text{g/L}$ or $0.1~\mu\text{g/mL}$LC/MS: $500~\mu\text{g/L}$ or $0.5~\mu\text{g/mL}$

```{r}
gcms_raw <- c(table1_data, table2_data)
lcms_raw <- c(table3_data, table4_data, table5_data)

# numeric and multiply by 0.2 to get µg/mL
gc_num <- as.numeric(gcms_raw) * 0.2
lc_num <- as.numeric(lcms_raw) * 0.2

loq_gc <- 0.1 
loq_lc <- 0.5

# For GC/MS
gc_cens <- data.frame(
  left = ifelse(is.na(gc_num), NA, gc_num),
  right = ifelse(is.na(gc_num), loq_gc, gc_num)
)

# For LC/MS
lc_cens <- data.frame(
  left = ifelse(is.na(lc_num), NA, lc_num),
  right = ifelse(is.na(lc_num), loq_lc, lc_num)
)

# Fit log-normal distributions using fitdistcens
fit_gc_norm <- fitdistcens(gc_cens, "norm")
fit_lc_norm <- fitdistcens(lc_cens, "norm")

fit_gc_lnorm <- fitdistcens(gc_cens, "lnorm")
fit_lc_lnorm <- fitdistcens(lc_cens, "lnorm")

fit_gc_gamma <- fitdistcens(gc_cens, "gamma")
fit_lc_gamma <- fitdistcens(lc_cens, "gamma")

# Compare AIC
summary(fit_gc_norm)$aic
summary(fit_gc_lnorm)$aic
summary(fit_gc_gamma)$aic

# Compare AIC
summary(fit_lc_norm)$aic
summary(fit_lc_lnorm)$aic
summary(fit_lc_gamma)$aic

```
```{r}
df_gc <- data.frame(conc = as.numeric(gc_num))

# GC Q-Q Plots
q_gc_n <- ggplot(df_gc, aes(sample = conc)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qnorm, dparams = list(mean = fit_gc_norm$estimate["mean"], sd = fit_gc_norm$estimate["sd"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm, dparams = list(mean = fit_gc_norm$estimate["mean"], sd = fit_gc_norm$estimate["sd"]), color = "darkblue") +
  labs(title = "GC: Normal Q-Q") + theme_minimal()

q_gc_ln <- ggplot(df_gc, aes(sample = conc)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = fit_gc_lnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = fit_gc_lnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = fit_gc_lnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = fit_gc_lnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), color = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "GC: Log-normal Q-Q") + theme_minimal()

q_gc_g <- ggplot(df_gc, aes(sample = conc)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fit_gc_gamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fit_gc_gamma$estimate["rate"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fit_gc_gamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fit_gc_gamma$estimate["rate"]), color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "GC: Gamma Q-Q") + theme_minimal()

q_gc_n + q_gc_ln + q_gc_g
```

```{r}
summary(fit_gc_lnorm)
```

```{r}
summary(fit_lc_lnorm)
```

```{r}
q_lc_n + q_lc_ln + q_lc_g
```

## Proportion below the LOQ

```{r}
gcms_nd_pct <- sum(c(table1_data, table2_data) == "N.D.") / length(c(table1_data, table2_data)) * 100
lcms_nd_pct <- sum(c(table3_data, table4_data, table5_data) == "N.D.") / length(c(table3_data, table4_data, table5_data)) * 100

cat(sprintf("\nGC/MS N.D. Percentage: %.1f%%\n", gcms_nd_pct))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS N.D. Percentage: %.1f%%\n", lcms_nd_pct))
```

## Proportion below the LOQ

```{r}
gcms_nd_pct <- sum(c(table1_data, table2_data) == "N.D.") / length(c(table1_data, table2_data)) * 100
lcms_nd_pct <- sum(c(table3_data, table4_data, table5_data) == "N.D.") / length(c(table3_data, table4_data, table5_data)) * 100

cat(sprintf("\nGC/MS N.D. Percentage: %.1f%%\n", gcms_nd_pct))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS N.D. Percentage: %.1f%%\n", lcms_nd_pct))
```

LOQ GC/MS: $100~\mu\text{g/L}$ or $0.1~\mu\text{g/mL}$LC/MS: $500~\mu\text{g/L}$ or $0.5~\mu\text{g/mL}$

```{r}
gcms_raw <- c(table1_data, table2_data)
lcms_raw <- c(table3_data, table4_data, table5_data)

# numeric and multiply by 0.2 to get µg/mL
gc_num <- as.numeric(gcms_raw) * 0.2
lc_num <- as.numeric(lcms_raw) * 0.2

loq_gc <- 0.1 
loq_lc <- 0.5

# For GC/MS
gc_cens <- data.frame(
  left = ifelse(is.na(gc_num), NA, gc_num),
  right = ifelse(is.na(gc_num), loq_gc, gc_num)
)

# For LC/MS
lc_cens <- data.frame(
  left = ifelse(is.na(lc_num), NA, lc_num),
  right = ifelse(is.na(lc_num), loq_lc, lc_num)
)

# Fit log-normal distributions using fitdistcens
fit_gc_norm <- fitdistcens(gc_cens, "norm")
fit_lc_norm <- fitdistcens(lc_cens, "norm")

fit_gc_lnorm <- fitdistcens(gc_cens, "lnorm")
fit_lc_lnorm <- fitdistcens(lc_cens, "lnorm")

fit_gc_gamma <- fitdistcens(gc_cens, "gamma")
#fit_lc_gamma <- fitdistcens(lc_cens, "gamma")

# Compare AIC
summary(fit_gc_norm)$aic
summary(fit_gc_lnorm)$aic
summary(fit_gc_gamma)$aic

# Compare AIC
summary(fit_lc_norm)$aic
summary(fit_lc_lnorm)$aic
summary(fit_lc_gamma)$aic

```

```{r}
summary(fit_gc_lnorm)
```

```{r}
summary(fit_lc_lnorm)
```

# Comparison GC

```{r}
dist_params <- data.frame(
  Material = c("USPF", "C-USPF", "CGF", "UFC-CGF", "FC-CGF"),
  meanlog  = c(-1.745, -5.290, -2.599, -4.451, -2.495),
  sdlog    = c(4.67, 5.98, 5.16, 5.90, 4.96)
)

x_values <- 10^seq(-4, 3)

plot_data <- dist_params %>%
  group_by(Material) %>%
  do(data.frame(
    Concentration = x_values,
    Density = dlnorm(x_values, .$meanlog, .$sdlog),
    Probability = plnorm(x_values, .$meanlog, .$sdlog)
  ))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Concentration, y = Density, color = Material)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "PDF", x = "Concentration (µg/mL)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Concentration, y = Probability, color = Material)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "CDF", y = "Cumulative Probability") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Average meanlog ($\mu$): $-3.316$Average sdlog ($\sigma$): $5.334$
